INTERVAL EVENTS: No acute overnight events. Wound vac changed by nursing.

SUBJECTIVE: Pain 4/10 at surgical site, improved. Denies fever, chills, drainage.

MEDICATIONS: Vancomycin 1.25g q12h; Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375g q6h; Oxycodone 5 mg q6h PRN.

OBJECTIVE:
Vitals: Temp 99.1 F, HR 88, BP 128/76, RR 16, SpO2 98% RA.
Exam: Abdominal wound clean, wound vac intact, minimal serous drainage.
Labs: WBC 11.4, Hgb 10.6, Albumin 3.1 (L), Prealbumin 14 (L).
Wound culture: MRSA positive.
CT abdomen: No undrained collection.

ASSESSMENT: 59-year-old man with MRSA surgical site infection, post-op day 6.

PLAN:
Problem 1: MRSA wound infection
- Continue vancomycin; de-escalate pip-tazo per cultures
- Wound care team following; continue wound vac
Problem 2: Malnutrition
- Nutrition consult; high-protein diet
- Consider tube feeds if PO inadequate
Problem 3: Pain
- Multimodal analgesia; wean opioids
